sourceBinding.finalCommitAndTree: Root passes from an external sealed input after all product and recipe files are committed.
sourceBinding.sourceArchive: Deterministic gzip mtime=0 of git archive for the external commit, with prefix waypair-link-source/.
sourceBinding.sourceOffer: Generated during notices preparation from that commit, archive URL, and actual archive SHA-256.
sourceBinding.selfReference: No final source/tree/archive hash is stored in this in-tree inventory or operator.

sourceClosureFiles.role: Root build, notices, package and normal signing orchestration
External source seal and frozen per-file/input guards
Source-relative app assembly and license/notices inclusion
Derive actual minimum macOS from bundled Mach-O slices
UDZO DMG creation and existing-key signature binding
This logical inventory; final source identifiers remain external

retainedIdentity.rule: Use existing Root-held identities and public-key pins only; do not create, rotate, export, or embed secret key material.

frozenMac49Baseline.preservation: Do not overwrite installed Mac49/local.21, its source, source archive, bundle manifest, or DMG.

rootOnlyInputs.storage: External Root configuration and scratch, excluded from repository and archive.
rootOnlyInputs.pathPolicy: Root command-line selections are resolved and byte-checked against immutable V3 input pins before seal/output creation; the public guard repeats selected executable/helper checks. Staged updater, ADB, and provenance copies use retained pins; Sparkle, license, and Qt Homebrew inputs are compared with the frozen Mac49 manifest; Qt source/catalog bytes use retained hashes. No personal absolute path is embedded in public source.
rootOnlyInputs.credentials: No credentials or private keys are carried in this source closure.

publication.recipePlacement: Included in the exact source archive; no extra publisher asset or new publisher endpoint is needed.

acceptance.sourceReview: Fresh independent review must bind the final integrated source commit/tree and exact Root driver/template hashes.
